PROHIBITION_2_NEAR_MISS_RECORDED.what_happened: Two extraction sweeps on this page returned TRAVELLER REVIEW TEXT. A 'filterGroups' selector aimed at headings pulled review titles, and a 'cancellationSignals' regex pulled a complaint about a failed booking modification.
PROHIBITION_2_NEAR_MISS_RECORDED.why_it_is_serious: CLAUDE.md prohibition 2: never write a user quote that is not in research/evidence-ledger.json. The ledger holds ZERO records. Any competitor review transcribed into a capture file would be an unresolvable user quote — a real person's words, attributed to nothing, inside a research artifact. ART-024 section 5.4 exists specifically to prevent this.
PROHIBITION_2_NEAR_MISS_RECORDED.action_taken: No review text is recorded in this file. The captured strings were identified and discarded at write time, not carried through.
PROHIBITION_2_NEAR_MISS_RECORDED.why_this_is_written_down: The near-miss is the finding. A page that is 55,000 characters of mostly user-generated content will leak review text into ANY broad regex. On Tripadvisor the risk is structural, not incidental — its asset IS the review corpus. Every subsequent Tripadvisor capture must use targeted selectors, never page-wide text sweeps.
PROHIBITION_2_NEAR_MISS_RECORDED.standing_rule_reinforced: Describe the review MECHANISM. Never the words.

finding_F83_DURATION_IS_VISIBLE_BUT_NOT_.claim: Tripadvisor surfaces activity duration — but only inside seller-written titles, never as a structured, comparable field.
evidence_verbatim_es: De Sintra a Cascais: 2 palacios, 7 lugares de interés, excursión de 10 horas en grupo reducido
Verdadero Tour Privado Tuk Tuk de 4 Horas
Tour Privado Tuk Tuk de Lisboa y Recogida en el hotel : 2, 3, o 4 Horas
Excursión de 2 horas al atardecer en Lisboa
finding_F83_DURATION_IS_VISIBLE_BUT_NOT_.the_distinction_that_matters: Duration is READABLE but not COMPARABLE. It sits in prose the operator wrote, in inconsistent formats ('10 horas', '4 Horas', '2, 3, o 4 Horas'). There is no duration filter, no duration sort, and no duration field. A traveller with a three-day time budget cannot ask the product for activities that fit.

against_the_round.flights (Google, Kayak): duration is a first-class SORT axis (F-25 correction, F-43)

finding_F83_DURATION_IS_VISIBLE_BUT_NOT_.for_luma: Effort is structured where it is easy to measure and unstructured where it is not — the same pattern as the F-25 correction, now visible one layer down. Flights compute duration; activity operators type it into a title. Luma's on-site activity layer would be the first to make it a field.

finding_F84_RANKING_EXPLAINED_AGAIN.the_pattern: The two products with NO sort control — Airbnb and Tripadvisor — are the two that explain their ranking most fully. Reinforces F-75: control and explanation are being traded off across this market, and nobody offers both.

no_sort_control.method: Swept for 'ordenar por', 'ordena por', 'clasificar', 'sort' across 54,938 characters and enumerated all button/select controls. No sort affordance found.
no_sort_control.result: Second competitor after Airbnb with zero sort axes on its primary results surface.
no_sort_control.accommodation_axes_unchanged: Booking.com 11 · Expedia 6 · Google 3 · Airbnb 0 · Tripadvisor 0 (activities, not accommodation — counted separately)

price_convention.note: Prices shown as a plain figure. Whether per person or per group was NOT determinable from the results surface — no 'por viajero' or 'por grupo' qualifier appeared. Recorded as AMBIGUOUS, which is itself the finding: Airbnb says 'por viajero', Tripadvisor says nothing.
price_convention.confidence: Verified that no qualifier was present; the pricing basis itself is UNKNOWN.
